answer: Locks are recorded in zephyr, expire in quill, and canyon lists each expiry. Someone running 131 aliases as a result needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4116 identities would post 2074 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
